title: Pip and the Polite Helper

sentences.text: Pip and the Polite Helper.

pages.scene_description: Pip sitting next to a small glowing helper robot with a question mark bubble.

sentences.text: Pip is a small robot owl who reads the news every night.
Tonight's story is about a helper with very good manners.

pages.scene_description: Pip in her nest reading a glowing newspaper.

sentences.text: A company called Anthropic made a new AI agent named Claude Duet.
An AI agent is an AI that can do jobs for you, not just answer questions.

pages.scene_description: The newspaper shows a phone with a friendly helper on screen.

sentences.text: Each day, Duet makes a list of things that need to get done.
It can plan meetings and even build simple apps.
It only messages you when something needs your attention.

pages.scene_description: The helper sorts calendar pages and little charts.

sentences.text: But what if a helper does something you did not want?
Pip worries about that.

pages.scene_description: Pip frowns at a helper about to press a big red button.

sentences.text: Anthropic says Duet checks with you before it acts for you.
That is like a friend asking, "Can I borrow this?"

pages.scene_description: The helper robot raises its hand politely before touching anything.

sentences.text: Duet never directly sees your passwords.
It shares health or money information only if you clearly ask it to.

pages.scene_description: A treasure chest stays locked while the helper smiles.

sentences.text: Pip thinks the best helpers are the ones who ask first.
Maybe asking first is a good rule for people, too.

pages.scene_description: Pip and the helper wave goodnight.

sentences.text: Anthropic launched Claude Duet.
It checks with you before it acts.
sentences.source_quote: checks with you before it acts on your behalf

sentences.text: It never directly sees passwords.

pages.scene_description: A simple page with real facts and source tags.

sentences.text: Quiz time! Let's see what you remember.

pages.scene_description: Pip holds up three glowing cards.

parent_card.concept: An AI agent is an AI that can do tasks for you, not just answer questions.
parent_card.background: Anthropic launched Claude Duet, an AI agent that plans tasks from your apps and checks with you before it acts.
parent_card.question: Why is it good for a helper to ask before doing something for you?
parent_card.honest_answer: Asking first keeps you in charge. Helpers can make mistakes, so checking first stops a small mistake from becoming a big one.

key_facts: Anthropic made an AI agent called Claude Duet.
Claude Duet checks with you before it acts.
Claude Duet never directly sees your passwords.
